policy: Public-repository documentation may contain architecture, procedures, statuses and secret-location names, but never credential values, MFA recovery material, privileged legal communications, claim strategy, bank credentials or private provider contract terms. The master is generated from canonical machine-readable sources and this register; it is not an independent source of transaction truth.

safe_auto_fix: Regenerate docs/MASTER.md from canonical machine-readable inputs.
Rebuild owner-facing status tables and documentation links from the register.
Fail CI when a required registered document is missing or a docs/*.md file is unregistered.
Fail CI when a private-record class is incorrectly assigned a repository path.
Fail normal and LIVE system gates when the committed master is stale.
never_auto_decide: Legal approval, legal interpretation or counsel clearance.
Provider selection, contracting, confidential pricing or automation approval.
Security exceptions or acceptance of material residual risk.
Repository visibility, branch protection or other external administrator controls.
Where confidential/privileged material should be stored beyond the approved storage class.
LIVE readiness solely because documentation exists.
